newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pope leaves France for home.
newsitem.headline: Pope leaves France for home.

text.p: Pope John Paul left for home on Sunday at the end of a four-day visit, his fifth to mainland France.
Prime Minister Alain Juppe bade the 76-year-old Pope farewell at an airbase near the eastern town of Reims. The Pontiff is scheduled to visit France again next August for World Youth Day.

The tour stirred controversy over his tribute to the baptism of mediaeval king Clovis, which the Roman Catholic Church and the Right see as marking the birth of France, and because some public funds were spent on facilities for the visit.
But protests by secularists and leftists were low-key.
The Pope looked relatively robust throughout his gruelling schedule, which also included Brittany and the Vendee.
It was his last foreign trip before he undergoes surgery to remove his appendix next month.
